sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You emphasise both your skilled team and our long relationship—it sounds like preserving continuity is central to how you approach this adjustment. We value that partnership and want an agreement that recognises the wage impact in proportion to its share of your costs. How could a longer contractual commitment help you manage that pressure while keeping the adjustment aligned with that impact?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the binding volume of 4,000 units per year, which provides valuable planning security and allows us to optimize production.
However, extending payment terms to 60 days is not feasible for our family-run business.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €51.30 per unit.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You welcome long-term commitment but rule out extended payment—it sounds like predictability must cover cash flow as well as production. We value this partnership and want a transparent, cost-based agreement supported by reliable, on-time payment. How can we establish a shared cost basis that fairly reflects the pressures on your business?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.23 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
